The refreshed exact M6 and W9 wrappers returned no decodable video. The current index still exposes no exact authorized 6ter source except private-IP or territory/account-bound delivery, which was rejected.

The current Canal+ wrapper did not decode and remains an open/en-clair candidate rather than the exact full paid linear service. No inexact substitution was published.

ParaTV advanced through commit d42c867a at 20:26 UTC and a89024f at 21:25 UTC. The France 2, France 3, and France 5 wrappers retained the same current sources: their manifests and AES-128 keys return 200, but every tested current media segment returns 403. This is fresh current evidence, not a stale failure.

Official CStar Dailymotion metadata for x5gv5v0 still returns owner-controlled DM007 geo restriction and HTTP 403. The ParaTV token was intentionally rejected because publishing it would bypass that explicit territory decision.

The current M6 and W9 resolver paths return HTTP 403. The latest maintained lineup exposes no exact portable M6 source; W9 and 6ter remain available only through territory/account-bound licensed services or inexact Swiss variants, not an authorized non-DRM IPTVX feed.
CANAL+'s current live distribution continues to place the exact full Canal+ service inside authenticated paid delivery. Open sources remain Canal+ en clair rather than the exact full linear target.
France 2, France 3, France 5, M6, W9, 6ter, full Canal+, and CStar therefore remain unpublished rather than being replaced by DRM, geo-bypassed, private-IP, or inexact variants.

ParaTV advanced to stream commit 9adcbd07 and playlist commit 7b0d3072 at 22:25–22:26 UTC. Fresh exact France 2, France 3, and France 5 720p media manifests returned HTTP 200, but every tested current segment returned HTTP 403; these remain current rights failures rather than stale URLs.

Fresh exact M6 and W9 wrappers exposed no decodable video, the current maintained tree still contains no exact 6ter resolver, and the full Canal+ wrapper exposed no decodable exact paid linear service.

The official France.tv app confirms exact France 2, France 3, and France 5 live delivery but explicitly limits some video by legal territory; M6+ confirms exact M6, W9, and 6ter live delivery inside its app/account service; and CANAL+ confirms account/subscription-bound live delivery. None supplied an authorized portable non-DRM HLS URL for IPTVX.

The fresh research and the complete cloud regression found no newly viable exact legal non-DRM target; all 12 published channels remained healthy and no channel was quarantined.

CStar's official Dailymotion live remained owner-geo-restricted; the maintained wrapper remained only 848x480 and conflicted with that owner restriction. The current Canal+ resolver exposed only Canal+ en clair rather than the exact full paid linear service. No bypass or inexact substitute was published.

The individual relay returned 15 of 15 fresh HTTP 200 responses; production relay version 23 then coalesced 20-second index/master refreshes, passed a 20-request concurrent burst at 20 of 20 HTTP 200, and the audit checker was bounded to two concurrent channels for this source family.
The fresh expansion pass found no newly viable exact legal non-DRM target. The complete repaired cloud regression and forced IPTVX reload retained all 12 published channels with no quarantine.

Fresh ParaTV checks found no decodable media in the exact France 2, France 3, and France 5 wrappers. The current iptv-org candidates for those channels, M6, 6ter, and CStar were private-IP restreams and were rejected.

The official M6, W9, and 6ter HLS masters remain SAMPLE-AES/FairPlay protected. W9's former clear official 6cloud path returned HTTP 403 on three attempts; full Canal+ remains paid/DRM, while the open resolver exposes only the inexact Canal+ en clair window.

channels.name: France 2
channels.reason: France.tv exposes an SSAI manifest, but its media segments return 403 from the US; a fresh 2026-07-25 extraction again returned a current AES-128 playlist while real decoding failed on the protected media/key request. Free TV's exact France 2 service (201) was also audited: every tested HLS audio/video rendition is SAMPLE-AES/FairPlay encrypted and its player requires account and TV-rights tokens for the license request. Molotov Basic carries the exact channel, but its current public state marks it unavailable from the US; channel APIs require an authenticated session and Molotov confirms its delivery uses DRM. Licensed Swiss provider netplus carries exact France 2, but its HLS origin completes TLS and then returns no HTTP response from the US; Teleboy and Salt likewise require Swiss service/account access. POST Luxembourg's 2026-07-24 catalog and Zattoo Switzerland both carry exact France 2, but POST requires its Internet+TV subscription and decoder before Apple TV access, while Zattoo prohibits Swiss live TV outside Switzerland and blocks hosting/proxy use. ParaTV's freshly regenerated exact wrapper still yielded no decodable media from the US. The current maintained public resolver otherwise offers only an untrusted private-IP restream, and Samsung TV Plus's current French FAST catalog contains no exact France 2.

channels.name: Canal+
channels.reason: The full linear channel requires a paid CANAL+ entitlement and DRM. Free TV exposes only a CANAL+ fallback service (1024), not an entitlement-free full linear feed; its HLS is SAMPLE-AES/FairPlay and its DASH is Widevine-protected. Molotov's catalog entry likewise does not expose an entitlement-free full linear source and its channel API requires authentication. netplus and current French operator catalogs explicitly separate CANAL+ free-view windows from the paid full CANAL+ service, while POST Luxembourg and Zattoo's current lineups do not provide the full channel. ParaTV's full-channel resolver currently serves only an unavailable placeholder; its working official-CDN resolver is explicitly CANAL+ en clair and therefore not the full linear service. Samsung TV Plus's current French FAST catalog contains no exact CANAL+. No legitimate direct IPTVX-compatible M3U source exists.
